answer_sentences.text: Yes—this loan falls within the category of floating-rate business loans to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises, which are covered by the rule for Tier 3 UCBs.
answer_sentences.quote: "For all floating rate loans granted for business purpose to individuals and Micro and Small Enterprises (as defined in Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises Development (MSMED) Act, 2006), with or without co-obligant(s):"

answer_sentences.text: However, a Tier 3 UCB is barred from levying pre-payment charges only on loans with a sanctioned amount or limit up to ₹50 lakh, and this loan is ₹60 lakh, so the prohibition does not apply.
answer_sentences.quote: "A Small Finance bank, a Regional Rural bank, a Tier 3 Primary (Urban) Co-operative bank, State Cooperative bank, Central Cooperative bank and an NBFC- ML shall not levy any pre-payment charges on loans with sanctioned amount/ limit up to ₹50 lakh."
